claims.statement: Ben Hogan asked for the Allen-Hogan fight to be postponed for two weeks, and Tom Allen agreed to the postponement.
claims.excerpt: He wanted the fight postponed for two weeks,

claims.statement: Tom Allen and Ben Hogan were to fight again on November 19 in Canada, within fifty miles of Detroit, with the stakes raised to $2,500 a side.

claims.statement: Tom Allen said that if he won his fight with Ben Hogan, he would make a match with Ed O'Baldwin for $2,500 or $5,000 a side.

claims.statement: Illinois Gov. Beveridge sent Col. E. L. Higgins, adjutant general, to East St. Louis with a hundred stands of arms to prevent the Allen-Hogan fight.

notes: The Nov. 19 Canada match was planned, not fought, so it is a challenge and has no fights entry. The officer's name is printed as 'Ei £. Higeims' (OCR); read as E. L. Higgins, as in another article.
